components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 0 18px; background: var(--green, #176b4d); color: #fff; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font: 750 14px/1.2 'Geist Variable', Geist, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 7px 18px rgba(23,107,77,.2); transition: background-color .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--green-hover, #105a40); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #247499); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.css: .ds-draft { max-width: 720px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface, #fffdf7); color: var(--ink, #18211e); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 14px 36px rgba(45,42,30,.09)); overflow: hidden; font: 14px/1.55 'Geist Variable', Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-draft header { padding: 22px 24px 14px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; } .ds-draft header span { padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--green-soft, #dcebe2); color: var(--green, #176b4d); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 760; } .ds-draft .ds-context { margin: 0; padding: 0 24px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dcd6c8); font-weight: 660; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-draft section { max-width: 75ch; padding: 22px 24px 10px; line-height: 1.62; } .ds-draft section p { margin: 0 0 13px; } .ds-draft small { display: block; padding: 0 24px 20px; color: var(--muted, #68716c); }

components.css: .ds-rail { width: 238px; padding: 12px 17px; background: var(--rail, #0e2937); display: grid; gap: 6px; font: 640 13px/1 'Geist Variable', Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-rail a { min-height: 48px; border-radius: 12px; padding: 0 13px; color: var(--rail-muted, #a9bcc3); display: flex; align-items: center; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .18s ease, color .18s ease; } .ds-rail a:hover { background: var(--rail-hover, #183947); color: #fff; } .ds-rail a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #247499); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-rail .ds-active { background: #f8f5eb; color: #17384b; font-weight: 760; }

components.name: Attention Record
components.description: A human-review conflict that interrupts the dispatch flow.
components.css: .ds-attention { width: 100%; min-height: 88px; padding: 16px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--warning-bg, #fff0ce); color: var(--warning-ink, #6f410d); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(180px,.7fr) minmax(220px,1fr); align-items: center; gap: 16px; text-align: left; font: 13px/1.45 'Geist Variable', Geist, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-attention:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 28px color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning-ink, #6f410d) 10%, transparent); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-attention:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #247499); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-attention i { width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 10px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-style: normal; font-weight: 850; } .ds-attention span:first-of-type { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-attention small { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning-ink, #6f410d) 70%, transparent); }

components.css: .ds-audit-event { min-height: 102px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 96px 28px 1fr; gap: 14px; color: var(--ink, #18211e); font: 13px/1.5 'Geist Variable', Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-audit-event time { padding-top: 1px; color: var(--muted, #68716c); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; } .ds-audit-event i { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 24px; height: 24px; border: 3px solid var(--paper, #f4f1e8); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--saffron, #c77829); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--saffron, #c77829); } .ds-audit-event i::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 9px; top: 22px; width: 1px; height: 76px; background: var(--line, #dcd6c8); } .ds-audit-event div { padding: 14px 16px; margin: -14px 0 18px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--warning-bg, #fff0ce); color: var(--warning-ink, #6f410d); } .ds-audit-event strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-audit-event p { margin: 0; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning-ink, #6f410d) 78%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
Topline feels like a quiet Indian dispatch ledger made operational: warm paper carries dense, readable records; a deep ink rail anchors orientation; and status color behaves like a clerk's verification mark. The interface is calm but not sparse. It keeps invoice amounts, full email drafts, reasons, timestamps, and access boundaries visible so a business owner can make a safe decision quickly.

The cockpit earns trust through evidence rather than reassurance alone. Approval controls stay close to the complete draft, warnings interrupt the flow in saffron paper, and every automated act remains legible in a time-stamped rail. On a phone, the same record structure compresses without hiding meaning: navigation stays fixed, approval actions stay within one-handed reach, and tables become labelled cards.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and white ledger sheets against an ink-navy orientation rail.
Compact, number-conscious Geist typography with full drafts kept readable.
Green verification, saffron attention, and red refusal used as operational semantics.
Bordered records for reference data; soft elevation only for actionable document sheets.
Responsive transformations that preserve labels, context, and safety actions.

rules.name: The Signal Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Green confirms or approves, saffron asks for attention, and red marks rejection or critical delinquency; none is ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Warning Pair Rule
rules.body: Human-review conflicts use warning paper and warning ink together so the interruption remains readable in light and dark themes.

rules.name: The Whole Draft Rule
rules.body: Draft emails remain normal reading text with generous line-height; never compress them into previews before an approval action.

rules.name: The Ledger Number Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for money, dates, counts, overdue age, and audit time so records scan vertically.

rules.name: The Label Survives Rule
rules.body: When a table becomes cards, every value keeps an explicit field label through `data-label`; responsive simplification may change structure, never meaning.

rules.name: The One-Handed Decision Rule
rules.body: On small screens, fixed navigation and sticky approval actions must remain separated and simultaneously reachable.

rules.name: The Paper Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal paper for reference records; use ambient elevation only when a surface behaves like a document or persistent control layer.

rules.name: The Radius Follows Scale Rule
rules.body: Keep controls tighter than records and records tighter than document sheets; pills belong only to compact status metadata.

dos: Do keep the exact draft, agent reason, and send decision in the same document surface.
Do use green, saffron, and red only for their assigned operational meanings.
Do preserve timestamps, field labels, payment provenance, and access boundaries as visible evidence.
Do keep the 3px focus outline and reduced-motion fallback on new interactive components.
Do transform dense desktop records into labelled mobile cards and reserve clearance for fixed controls.
donts: Don't hide an email body behind truncation, a modal, or a preview when approval is available.
Don't use green for a pending action, saffron for decoration, or red for routine navigation.
Don't detach sticky actions from the draft they affect or let them overlap the mobile dock.
Don't replace explicit verification text with a mark alone; safety and access remain readable in plain language.
Don't add hard offset shadows, ornamental gradients, or glass effects outside the implemented sticky context layers.
